title: Sick food
summary: Get your mess meal delivered to your room when you're unwell (request on iKollege).

posts.md:
Feeling unwell and unable to go to the mess?

You can request **Sick Food**, where your regular mess meal will be delivered to your hostel room.

## Who can use it?

Hostel Students who are feeling sick and are unable to visit the mess.

## What do you get?

- Regular mess food
- Delivered to your hostel room

## How to Request

Submit your request through the official Sick Food portal:

https://ikollege.iitm.ac.in/iitmhostel/sickFoodRequest
**Tip:** If you're unable to submit the request yourself, you can ask a friend or your hostel's **Health & Hygiene Secretary** for assistance.
